name: After § 30
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 30b. Expresses major concern about the Commission’s proposal to make access to significant funding under the NRPPs and the ECF conditional upon the fulfilment of country-specific recommendations; recalls that similar conditionality in the context of the RRF has demonstrated serious shortcomings, including inconsistencies in the assessment of national reforms, the politicisation of the process, and insufficient accountability; stresses that replicating this approach risks undermining the credibility, ownership and effectiveness of both the European Semester and future EU funding; firmly opposes any extension of conditionality linked to country-specific recommendations without a comprehensive and transparent review of past failures;
